messages:
alex: Quick pre-oncall sanity check — I'm taking the 18:00 UTC handoff. Leaving in ~45m. Can everyone confirm the following before I go?
1) runbooks linked & up-to-date?
2) VPN / office creds valid for the shift?
3) pager access + test alert delivered?
4) observability / devtools access (read-only ok)
If you have any other risks or TODOs, flag them here.

priya: Runbooks — updated 15m ago, added a note about redis failover to step 4. Link: https://redwood/runbooks/prod-oncall (edited). :white_check_mark:

sam: VPN — I re-provisioned alex's VPN token earlier when alex said access dropped. You should have an invite email; if not, lemme know and I'll re-send.

esther: Pager — sent a test alert at 17:10 and it routed to the current rotation and to alex. oncall-bot shows alex on-shift. :thumbsup:

jen: Quick FYI: prod bastion SSH key expires tomorrow morning (2024-06-01). I created a ticket to rotate: https://issues/RED-1423. Dropped a temporary key for the shift at 1Password under "bastion/temp-key". Please rotate on first non-incident maintenance window.

alex: Got the test alert, thanks. Priya — can you confirm the curl healthcheck in runbook step 3 is the correct one? I remember we changed path last week.

priya: Confirmed — snippet is correct: `curl -fsS https://api.redwood/prod/health || echo "service down"` — returns 200 in canary.

sam: Heads-up — CI flakiness might produce noisy alerts late tonight. I added a temporary suppression rule for the flaky job to avoid paging on false positives (will expire at 06:00 UTC).

ops-bot: scheduled test alert at 1715004800 — status: delivered -> alex.

esther: One more: observability read token shared via 1Password (item: observability/read-only). You should have access to traces/dashboards; if anything is missing DM me.

alex: Thanks all — I see everything green. Leaving a short handoff note in the runbook: "Rotate bastion key + verify VPN token expiry after shift" :memo:. If anything urgent ping me or escalate to @oncall. Taking over in 10.

oncall-bot: handoff recorded by alex at 1715003600. Shift starts 18:00 UTC.
